description: The shared Renovate preset of zeabur-oss: extend it with "github>zeabur-oss/.github". Commits sign off, as the DCO check requires of every commit.

packageRules.description: One pull request for compatible crate updates; majors stay separate.
kube and its companion crates each require one k8s-openapi minor, so they move together in one pull request, majors included.
The pins of zeabur-oss/.github move in the Update workflow: the shared workflows and actions, @zeabur-oss/release in package.json and the flake input in flake.lock.
Our own packages and releases (@zeabur-oss/* on npm, zeabur-oss/* tags and releases) move as soon as they are published; third-party packages wait seven days.
